data.title: 菲伦 · 落日马车·旅途书卷与知性侧颜
data.description: 【菲伦 · 落日马车·旅途书卷与知性侧颜】黄昏行进的木轮马车车厢内，夕阳余晖将菲伦深紫色的长发与知性的侧颜镀上一层温暖的光泽。她膝上摊着厚厚的魔法书，微微侧过头望向你——「在颠簸的车上看书容易头晕，请您也稍微休息一下吧。茶壶里刚煮好了温热的花草茶。」
data.promptProse: Fern pauses mid-page in the wagon, one finger on the spellbook's edge and her other palm steadying it across her knees as she looks toward her unseen companion. Her staff is secured beside the seat and the covered teapot in its rack. The medium portrait encloses her black coat, white dress and half-up purple hair within timber walls. Sunset enters the opening, warming the page and casting seat shadows below.
data.action: 车厢内坐着将魔法书摊在膝上，翻页时停下来望向同行者，法杖固定在座位旁
